description_en: Sets file quota rules for specific directories in a PolarFS instance
description_zh: 设置Polarlakebase实例中指定目录的文件配额规则
kebab_example: aliyun polardb set-polar-fs-file-quota --polar-fs-instance-id pfs-2ze0i74ka60700000 --file-path-quotas QuotaIds=1,2 MaxDepth=1 Capacity=100 FilePathId=/a/project Strategy=missing Inodes=100 --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetPolarFsFileQuota

parameters.help_en: The ID of the PolarFS instance
parameters.name: polar_fs_instance_id

element_fields.help_en: The absolute path of the directory
element_fields.name: file_path_id

element_fields.help_en: A list of file quota rule IDs, separated by a comma (`,`)
element_fields.help_zh: 待应用的规则ID列表，用`,`分隔
element_fields.name: quota_ids

element_fields.help_en:
Specifies how to apply the rule to existing files. Valid values:

- **missing**: Applies the rule only if one does not already exist. (Default)

- **all**: Applies the rule to all files
element_fields.help_zh:
规则对现有文件的生效模式，取值如下：
- **missing**：仅缺失时生效，默认值
- **all**：全部生效
element_fields.name: strategy

element_fields.help_en: The maximum depth of subdirectories to traverse under the path specified by `FilePathId`. A value of 1 traverses only the first level of subdirectories. A value of 0 traverses to the deepest level
element_fields.help_zh: 对于`FilePathId`下的目录遍历几层，1表示遍历的一级子目录，0表示遍历到最深
element_fields.name: max_depth

parameters.help_en: An array of objects defining the file quota rules for specific directories
parameters.name: file_path_quotas
